arg.name: certificate_path
arg.description: Path to the server certificate (DER format)

arg.name: private_key_path
arg.description: Path to the server private key (DER format)

arg.name: ca_certificate_path
arg.description: Path to the CA certificate for client verification (auto-enables verification)

arg.name: verbose
arg.description: Set the verbosity to false to disable OPC UA and ROS2 logs of Info severity and lower.

arg.name: ip_address
arg.description: Set the IP address for the example server.
